items.description: Welcome to Cognite.You are an employee of a classified research facility deep underground. Your job is to observe and interact with test subjects — beings that were once human. Each day is a new experiment. Each experiment is a step closer to the truth.But in Cognite, nothing is that simple. Anomalies bleed into reality, monsters break out of their cells, and the days begin to repeat. The choice between life and death is not always the same as the choice between truth and lies.What awaits you:The atmosphere of a secret bunker, inspired by SCP and time loops.An interactive tablet — your only weapon.Every run is unique — anomalies are generated randomly.Cognite. items.description: Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley──────────────────────────────Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you’re ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.🐎 Ride & explore────────────────────• Third-person horseback adventure across handcrafted 3D valleys—grass, light, and space to breathe.• Every outing has a honest goal on the HUD: collect every diamond tucked into the world.• Nail the set and the UI celebrates a full clear—a small victory lap for collectors who love a tidy map.💎 Diamonds that work for you──────────────────────────────────• Gems you pick up stick with you between sessions—your balance is always on screen.• Sink savings into new environments beyond your starter pasture, or into cosmetic unlocks for your horse.• Low on glitter? The interface tells you straight—no opaque economy tricks.🦄 Make the horse unmistakably yours──────────────────────────────────────────• Deep dressing room: size, coat, mane style & tint, saddle & reins, armor look & color, horn shape & color.• Preview everything in the customization hub, save a look you adore, and spend diamonds when a premium style calls your name.🗺️ Pastures waiting past the horizon──────────────────────────────────────────• The map picker shows art, title, and price—play what you own or buy the next dreamscape with saved diamonds.• Your first world is ready on day one; the rest open when you decide the valley has earned another stamp in your passport.🌍 Play your way────────────────────• Tweak resolution, dial real-time shadows for performance, flip music—this is your session.• A shuffled soundtrack keeps menus and rides from feeling samey; fairy-tale calm follows you scene to scene.🎮 Controls that respect the couch──────────────────────────────────────• Keyboard & mouse feel natural; gamepad users get menus that behave.• Pause, adjust, or bounce to the main menu when life interrupts the ride—progress stays where you left it.🏆 Steam, quietly cheering you on────────────────────────────────────────• Achievements reward first rides, diamond milestones, full clears, visiting every map, saving looks, shopping, and coming back for more.✨ Who it’s for──────────────────Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, high-satisfaction pocket of magic: wander, shimmer, restyle, unlock, repeat. If gentle fantasy, shiny goals, and a unicorn-worthy mount sound like your kind of Sunday—saddle up.📣 Stay in the loop──────────────────────Wishlists help wandering players find the valley. items.description: A cozy retail sim that was definitely not assembled the night before launch.Run your very own corner store! Stock the shelves, ring up customers, set your prices, and slowly come to terms with the fact that something is deeply, spiritually wrong with this building.The cola costs whatever it feels like. The empty boxes have opinions about where they want to be thrown. Customers pay by card because they are, frankly, too afraid to handle cash here. And the soundtrack? That's coming from a cassette the tape deck is currently eating, and no, you cannot turn it off, and no, we don't know whose voice that is.Features:🛒 Actual shopkeeping! Probably!📦 Physics that range from "fine" to "war crime"💸 A pricing system you control with your bare hands and zero guidance📼 An original Dreamcast-era soundtrack, lovingly run through a haunted cassette🐛 Bugs we have reclassified as "emergent atmosphere"👻 At least one (1) ghost. We think. Reports vary.It's not broken. It's brave. Wishlist now before it becomes self-aware. items.description: Visual novel, biopunk, ADV, sci-fi, horror, bio-horror, body-horror, adventureIt doesn't have a name. The locals simply call it the City. Lilies do not bloom here and the sun does not shine. There is no fresh breeze blowing here and you can't hear the birds singing.Josiah Kaviani, a young mathematician and statistician, starts his journey in this underground maze of cramped streets. He is talented and intelligent, but he has one terrible drawback – he is unbearably alone.But soon, Josiah will have a fateful encounter that will turn his whole life and make him break the shell he used to live in. A meeting with someone or, perhaps, something that is hidden in such depths that even the horrific City cannot reach them. Something so secret that the very knowledge of it can be deadly. items.description: ClayMonsters is a game where you shape, raise, and battle clay-like monsters with your own hands.Pit the monsters you’ve created against the CPU or other players, defeat powerful foes to earn points, and create even stronger monsters.■ Monster CreationIn Monster Edit, you can freely edit and paint the bodies of your clay monsters.Their shape, size, and body composition affect their stats and moves, and you can save and manage your models across multiple slots.■ TrainingIn Training mode, you’ll undergo a 5-day training regimen where you grow your monster by selecting actions. Amid varied daily events—such as motivation boosts, special events, and sudden attacks by powerful foes—you’ll learn new moves, rearrange your move set, and save and inherit your training progress.■ Skill TreeThe Skill Tree allows you to enhance starting stats and training efficiency.■ CombatCombat is real-time, one-on-one. You manage distance by moving in and out, and attack by combining multiple moves. There are also strategic elements such as counterattacks, limb destruction, knockbacks, and limb restoration. CPU battles include free matches and tournaments with varying difficulty levels (from Easy to Very Hard), while player-versus-player battles offer room code matches and random matches.■ Monster SharingIn the Exhibition Room, you can view and download other players’ creations, and save models you like to your own slots.■ Desktop PetWith the Desktop Pet feature, you can display the monsters you’ve created on your desktop. They move autonomously—walking around, resting, and sometimes sleeping—and you can relaunch the main game from the right-click menu.Translated with (free version)[Streaming & Video Content]Streaming and uploading gameplay videos of ClayMonsters is permitted.Monetization (including monetized streams and videos) is also allowed.However, the developer assumes no responsibility for any issues that occurduring streaming or video uploads—including technical problems, bugs, connection issues,data loss, or disputes with third parties.Please use at your own risk.Please refrain from redistributing game assets or posing as an official representative of this game. items.description: 📜 A Text-Driven Victorian Roguelike MysteryStep into the fog-drenched world of Persuasion, a haunting retro-inspired RPG where choices are dynamic, every shadow hides a secret and every whispered lie could be your last clue.There's a LOT going on behind the curtain with this game.---🎩 Victorian Gothic AtmosphereSet in the eerie halls of a decaying Victorian estate, Persuasion draws you into a labyrinth of candlelit corridors, locked attics and crumbling cellars—each filled with cryptic objects, ritualistic clues and unspeakable horrors. Lovecraftian madness blends with British restraint in this masterclass of moody mystery.---💀 Murder. Mystery. Madness.Unravel a chilling murder plot by:- 🔍 Investigating over 40 uniquely described rooms, from the Parlor to the Torture Chamber.- 🧠 Interrogating up to 8 suspects, each with their own alibis, motives and behavioral traits.- 📓 Tracking clues and suspicions through your interactive investigation journal.- 🎭 Evaluating suspect credibility using a dynamic truth-detection system based on your perception, sanity and recursive deduction tools from your journal.- 🩸 Engaging in deadly confrontations if the murderer strikes—or if you do.---🕹️ Retro Mechanics, Modern DepthWith its nostalgic ASCII-style map, fully text-driven interface and Choose-Your-Own-Adventure pacing, Persuasion pays tribute to the golden era of narrative games. But beneath the classic surface lies a modern engine featuring:- 🗺️ Procedurally generated mansions: each run is different.- 👁️ Fog-of-war navigation, blocked passages and hidden paths.- 📦 Inventory, stat-based character creation and clue discovery.- 🧍‍♂️ Dynamic NPC movement: suspects roam the mansion as you do, raising tension and uncertainty.- 💬 Hybrid interrogation-combat system: ask the wrong questions and you might bleed for it.- ⏳ Turn-based progression ensures that your choices shape the story… and the map.- 🧠 A sanity system: as your mind deteriorates, the world itself begins to distort.- 🗝 Persuasion ability: uncover hidden truths by probing suspects beyond ordinary dialogue.---🧠 Replayable, Deep and ImmersiveNo two playthroughs are alike (well... the odds are 10 ⁷⁰ to 1). With over 120 potential room nodes, branching paths, stat-based combat and randomized clue/alibi/motive & suspect combinations, Persuasion invites repeat investigations. A full session can last 2–5 hours, or stretch longer for completionists and careful sleuths.---👁️‍🗨️ Low Magic. High Dread.The world of Persuasion features subtle supernatural elements, rooted in psychological horror and spiritual dread. Sanity is your most fragile asset. As your mind fractures, room descriptions distort, text clarity declines and even the map can lie.
